sentences.text:
If an industrial species lived 50 million years ago,
*could we prove they were ever here?*
sentences.spoken: If an advanced industrial civilization existed on Earth fifty million years before humans, could we prove they were ever here?

sentences.text:
This is the *Silurian Hypothesis*,
a scientific study by NASA and astrophysics teams.
sentences.spoken: This is the Silurian Hypothesis, a scientific thought experiment published by NASA climatologist Gavin Schmidt and astrophysicist Adam Frank.

sentences.text:
Humans have existed for 300,000 years,
*less than 0.01%* of Earth's vast history.
sentences.spoken: Humans have existed for only three hundred thousand years, less than zero point zero one percent of Earth's four point five billion year history.

sentences.text:
56 million years ago, temperatures spiked
*by 8 degrees* in a sudden geological heartbeat.
sentences.spoken: Fifty-six million years ago, the Paleocene-Eocene Thermal Maximum saw global temperatures spike by eight degrees in a geological heartbeat.

sentences.text:
Fossilization is extraordinarily rare:
*less than 0.1%* of species ever become stone.
sentences.spoken: Fossilization is extraordinarily rare: less than a tiny fraction of one percent of all ancient species are ever preserved in rock.

sentences.text:
In just a few thousand years, our cities
*will weather and crumble into dust*.
sentences.spoken: In just a few millennia, our cities, steel skyscrapers, concrete highways, and dams will weather, crumble, and erode into dust.

sentences.text:
The only immortal traces would be
*plastics, carbon spikes, and radioactive isotopes*.
sentences.spoken: The only immortal traces left in the geological strata would be synthetic plastics, anomalous carbon isotope spikes, and long-lived radioactive plutonium isotopes.

sentences.text:
Our entire civilization will condense
*into a rock layer less than 2 millimeters thick*.
sentences.spoken: All traces of modern human civilization will eventually be compressed into a microscopic sedimentary rock layer less than two millimeters thick.

sentences.text:
In the abyss of deep time, civilizations rise
*and dissolve like a whisper in the stone*.
sentences.spoken: Looking into the abyss of deep time, civilizations rise, burn, and dissolve like a whisper in the rock layers of Earth.
